name: TRK Corporation
summary: TRK Corporation, alongside its associated companies, primarily focuses on the development and oversight of commercial property assets throughout Taiwan. Its diverse operations encompass the management of various retail shopping centers and the operation of "Game Love Paradise," a brand of family-oriented amusement parks. Furthermore, the firm extends its business activities into the sports and leisure tourism sector. TRK Corporation, which was established in 1962, is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.
